user.title: Connect NOTTY
user.description: Enter your NOTTY account email address to receive a verification code.

code.title: Enter NOTTY code
code.description: Enter the verification code sent to {email}.

abort.already_configured: This NOTTY account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same NOTTY account as this integration.

litter_box_one_key.name: Litter box one-key action
litter_box_one_key.description: Run one of the NOTTY app one-key litter box actions.

litter_box_action.name: Litter box action
litter_box_action.description: Call a NOTTY litter box action or setting. Litter reminder interval changes are allowed for enabled reminders with a changed valid cycle; reset and trash-bag interval changes remain blocked.

litter_box_schedule.name: Litter box cleaning schedules
litter_box_schedule.description: List, create, update, enable, disable or delete NOTTY cleaning plans. Times use the NOTTY schedule clock (HH:MM), with no timezone conversion. Creating or enabling a plan may schedule cleaning; cleaning mode is left unchanged.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: Required for update, enable, disable and delete. Obtain the exact ID with the list operation.

time.name: NOTTY schedule clock
time.description: Required for create and update. Use HH:MM as shown by the NOTTY schedule clock, without timezone conversion.

pet_profile.name: Pet profile
pet_profile.description: Read or edit an existing owned pet. Changes: name, birthday (YYYY-MM-DD), sex (1 male, 2 female), is_sterilization (Boolean), breed_id from the breed catalog. Preserves weight, units, images and all bindings.

pet_association.name: Pet association
pet_association.description: List or associate/disassociate one owned pet with an owned litter box. Preserves unrelated pets and bindings.

pet_memo.name: Pet memo
pet_memo.description: List/read/create/edit pet text memos. Writes require ownership. Changes: title, content, date (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM in the NOTTY memo clock), remind (Boolean). Attachments are unsupported.

notification_preferences.name: NOTTY notification preferences
notification_preferences.description: Read or block/unblock account-wide litter-box notification categories. The physical box selects the account. These cloud preferences are separate from HA notifications.

clear_statistics.name: Clear device statistics
clear_statistics.description: Permanently delete the selected litter box’s cloud statistics. This cannot be undone. Sensors refresh afterward; exact counter/history effects require owner validation.

device_time_zone.name: Device time zone
device_time_zone.description: Choose a server catalog ID and a valid IANA time zone. Inspect readback and the app. Preserving local DND clocks requires an additional settings write.
